meta.name: google-maps-reviews-api-skill
meta.description: This skill is designed to help users automatically extract reviews from Google Maps via the Google Maps Reviews API. Agent should proactively apply this skill when users request to find reviews for local businesses (e.g., coffee shops, clinics), monitor customer feedback for a specific brand or location, analyze sentiment of reviews for competitors, extract reviews for a chain of stores or services, track reputation of a local restaurant, gather user testimonials for a specific venue, conduct market research on service quality of local businesses, monitor reviews for a new retail location, collect feedback on public attractions or parks, identify common complaints for a specific service provider, research the best-rated places in a city, analyze recurring themes in reviews for a specific industry.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动提取谷歌地图评论用于分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量获取商家评论做分析
copy.tagline_en: Automatically extract Google Maps reviews for analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch collect business reviews for analysis

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能自动从 Google Maps 提取评论数据，包括作者、评分、评论文本、日期、点赞数等结构化信息。
howto.when: 当用户要求查找本地商家（如咖啡店、诊所）的评论、监控品牌反馈、分析竞品评论或进行市场调研时触发。

say.text: 帮我找一下北京三里屯附近咖啡店的评论。
say.note: Claude 会调用技能提取相关评论。

say.text: 分析一下这家餐厅最近一个月的差评。
say.note: Claude 会提取评论并分析情感。

say.text: 收集上海所有特斯拉门店的评分数据。
say.note: Claude 会按关键词和地点提取评论。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically extract reviews from Google Maps, including author name, rating, review text, date, likes count, and other structured data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask to find reviews for local businesses (e.g., coffee shops, clinics), monitor brand feedback, analyze competitor reviews, or conduct market research.

say_en.text: Find reviews for coffee shops near Sanlitun in Beijing.
say_en.note: Claude will use the skill to extract relevant reviews.

say_en.text: Analyze recent negative reviews for this restaurant.
say_en.note: Claude will extract reviews and perform sentiment analysis.

say_en.text: Collect ratings for all Tesla showrooms in Shanghai.
say_en.note: Claude will extract reviews by keyword and location.
